# GGSEG3D VISUALIZE

## 0. Data and libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(BBmisc)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(cluster)
library(stringr)
library(factoextra)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
library(emmeans)
library(influence.ME)
library(rstatix)
library(ggseg)
library(ggseg3d)
library(reticulate)
```

## 1. Visualize volumes

Select atlas, which hemisphere, and how the surface needs to be presented:

```{r}
atlas_data_left <- dk_3d %>%
  filter(surf == "inflated" & hemi == "left") %>%
  unnest(ggseg_3d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!region %in% c("corpus callosum")) # needs to be removed

atlas_data_right <- dk_3d %>%
  filter(surf == "inflated" & hemi == "right") %>%
  unnest(ggseg_3d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!region %in% c("corpus callosum")) # needs to be removed
```

```{r}
# This has no use, copied it from other R script just to check
mycols <- c(
  "lh_parstriangularis_area"           = "#e40303", 
  "lh_frontalpole_thickness"           = "#ff8c00", 
  "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness"  = "#ffed00", 
  "lh_superiorparietal_thickness"      = "#008026", 
  "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness"   = "#004dff", 
  "rh_superiorparietal_thickness"      = "#750787"
)
```

```{r}
atlas_data_left$ind <- 0
atlas_data_left[atlas_data_left$region=="pars triangularis",]$ind <- 1
atlas_data_left[atlas_data_left$region=="frontal pole",]$ind <- 2
atlas_data_left[atlas_data_left$region=="lateral orbitofrontal",]$ind <- 3
atlas_data_left[atlas_data_left$region=="superior parietal",]$ind <- 4

atlas_data_right$ind <- 0
atlas_data_right[atlas_data_right$region=="caudal middle frontal",]$ind <- 5
atlas_data_right[atlas_data_right$region=="superior parietal",]$ind <- 6
```

### 1.1. Left Hemisphere

**MAKE SURE IT OVERLAPS THE COLORS!!**

```{r}
highlight_LH_lat <- ggseg3d(.data = atlas_data_left,
        atlas = dk_3d,
        colour = "ind",
        text = "ind", na.colour = "#f0efeb",
        palette = c("#f0efeb" = 0, "#e40303" = 1, "#ff8c00" = 2, "#ffed00" = 3 , "#008026" = 4)) %>% 
  pan_camera("left lateral") %>% remove_axes() 
highlight_LH_lat
```

```{r}
highlight_LH_med <- ggseg3d(.data = atlas_data_left,
        atlas = dk_3d,
        colour = "ind",
        text = "ind", na.colour = "#f0efeb",
        palette = c("#f0efeb" = 0, "#e40303" = 1, "#ff8c00" = 2, "#ffed00" = 3 , "#008026" = 4)) %>% 
  pan_camera("left medial") %>% remove_axes() 
highlight_LH_med
```

### 1.3. Frontal

```{r}
highlight_LH_FRONTAL <- ggseg3d(.data = atlas_data_left,
        atlas = dk_3d,
        colour = "ind",
        text = "ind", na.colour = "#f0efeb",
        palette = c("#f0efeb" = 0, "#e40303" = 1, "#ff8c00" = 2, "#ffed00" = 3 , "#008026" = 4, "#004dff" = 5, "#750787" = 6)) %>% 
  pan_camera(
    camera = list(
      eye = list(x = 0.0, y = 1.9, z = -0.5),
      up  = list(x = 0.0, y = 0.0, z = 1.0)
    )
  ) %>% remove_axes() 
highlight_LH_FRONTAL
```

```{r}
highlight_RH_FRONTAL <- ggseg3d(.data = atlas_data_right,
        atlas = dk_3d,
        colour = "ind",
        text = "ind", na.colour = "#f0efeb",
        palette = c("#f0efeb" = 0, "#e40303" = 1, "#ff8c00" = 2, "#ffed00" = 3 , "#008026" = 4, "#004dff" = 5, "#750787" = 6)) %>% 
  pan_camera(
    camera = list(
      eye = list(x = 0.0, y = 1.9, z = -0.5),
      up  = list(x = 0.0, y = 0.0, z = 1.0)
    )
  ) %>% remove_axes() 
highlight_RH_FRONTAL
```
